Overview

Sarajevo is a city in Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina with a population of 275,000. The capital and largest city of Bosnia and Herzegovina, a cultural crossroads where East meets West, known for its Ottoman-era Baščaršija and the 1984 Winter Olympics legacy. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
